name: smartmark
author: Suraj Jaiswal
description: SmartMark - intelligent, local-first bookmark manager for Chrome (Manifest V3)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run icons && vite build
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../smartmark.zip . && cd .. && echo 'built smartmark.zip'
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run guard && npm run probe
